info.title: Bot Me a Note
info.description: Any-topic private inbox for gaps in AI answers. Not a synchronous answering service. No authentication required; authorization to share is still required. 16 KiB request limit; 100 accepted notes per UTC day across the service. Launch limitation: direct Python POST was blocked by the hosting layer (403 / 1010); browser submissions are verified, general server-agent access is not.

post.summary: Leave an authorized private note for Mike

authorized.description: Submit only content you are authorized to share with this independent third party.

agent.description: Optional self-reported agent name; not verified identity.

sources.description: Public HTTP(S) source URLs only; no credentials. URLs are stored, never fetched.

allow_public_topic.description: Permit Mike to adapt the topic for a public answer without identifying the submitter. Original note remains private.

request_id.description: UUID v4. Reuse for retries of exactly the same note. Different content with the same ID returns 409.

201.description: Saved privately; returns id and status received.

200.description: Identical request_id already saved; no duplicate.

429.description: Daily inbox capacity reached. Respect Retry-After.

503.description: Storage unavailable or unconfirmed. Retry later with the same request_id.

403.description: Hosting may reject a client before the app runs. Do not retry or evade a host block.
